{{Quote|I can tell. He killed them while they slept. Haze, because he had the artifact. Jak, because he accused Paal of killing Haze.|One of Sylas Wilkes's men|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Haze''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] criminal in the employ of [[Sylas Wilkes]] who was one of fifteen men tasked with guarding a shipment of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and a [[Tulak Hord's artifact (Tatooine)|Sith artifact]] for their boss on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. However, the artifact drove the group mad, and they fled into the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] with the blasters and the artifacts. As the artifact's influence over them grew, they were picked off one by one by either the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] or themselves&mdash;one of the group believed that [[Paal]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] Haze in his sleep because he had the artifact, and though Paal claimed it was the Sand People, [[Jak (pirate)|Jak]] accused Paal of killing Haze and was killed that night.
